title: asset
description: One entry of the envelope's assets[]: a picture this document carries. The bytes live in the asset store (store/assets/<sha256>, POST /api/assets); a write that names a sha256 the store lacks is refused (unknown_asset). The md body shows one with ![alt](asset:<sha256>), and may only name an attached one.

sha256.description: sha256 (lowercase hex) of the bytes in the asset store.

alt.description: What the picture shows, one line. The screen's caption and the img alt.
